title: Improvement pass declaration
description: What a caller declares inside payload.improve at any of the four doors: the boundary this pass runs at, how it fires, and - for a partner-finding boundary only - the one revision the caller is offering. There is no member for the promotion authority, the decision rule or the criterion: additionalProperties is false, so a caller that adds one is refused before anything runs rather than being allowed to soften the gate its own change is judged by.

boundary.description: Self-improvement runs at a ceremony, phase or structure boundary, never per iteration (OWNER.md, 2026-09-03). Both members are read: the loop id is derived from them, so one boundary is one pass and a re-fire of the same boundary resumes it rather than starting a second.

fire_mode.description: Selects the loop driver. in-one-process holds the whole pass in one process; one-iteration-per-fire keeps nothing between iterations, so a scheduler fires the next one into a process that has never seen this loop.

revision_offered.description: One candidate revision an outside caller offers. Permitted only when boundary.kind is partner-finding, and tried first for its metric - but it is gated like any other candidate and carries no criterion and no verdict.

gate.description: What the candidate is put through. It names a unit and a registered case set; it has nowhere to carry the criterion, which belongs to the evaluation capability and is resolved inside the scorer.

case_filter.description: Optional. Omitted or 'all' selects every case; a case id selects one; 'none' selects nothing, which the gate reports as inconclusive and never as a pass.
